experiments.scope: Constructibility of the variant dense parts (proof.md Sections 4.3, 7 and 13.2): it supports H2 only by showing that variants reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions, and H4 only through the cost of completing a Step-1 solution; it estimates no probability. It does not test the table of the whole family or the choice of examined variants. experiments/xtab.py rebuilds S, L* and the 222 embedded classes (the largest classes of the family G; the sandbox cannot hold the whole family) from their descriptors; trials 0..127 each use class (7 t mod 222) (128 distinct classes), choose (from SHAKE-256 of the seed) a variant a0 of it and l among the 28 elements of L* whose row 16 can hold, and build a 37-step semi-free-start collision whose second-block state uses the variant (rows 16..21 by proposals with each row's fixed x-bits of E imposed, restarting from row 16 after 2^11 proposals at a row; row 22 by W22 proposals with its x-cells and two-bit conditions imposed, W7 drawn exactly from F7, W6 = W22 - s1(W20) - W15 - s0(W7) accepted iff in F6; rows 22..36 with the variant's W8; W0..W5 by the inverse expansion; CV1 by inverting steps 7..0). A trial returns CV1||M1 and CV1||M1' (96 bytes each) iff: the Step-2 equations of (CV1, a0) give exactly W0..W13 of both members, the two 37-step outputs are equal, M1 != M1', every cell of rows -4..36 (W6/W7 XOR cells excepted) and every printed two-bit condition of rows 8..36 holds, a0 is in G and in its class, and W8 differs from the published one. In addition, for trials 0..15 the constructed chaining value is fed to the counted online program with the table restricted to the class of a0 and THETA = 1 (table read, fibre test, segment scan, packed u, direct row-16 mask lookup of every lane, rows 16..36), which must find exactly the constructed pair (observation detected_by_counted_program). Trials 128..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: about 128 (a trial can fail only by exhausting its proposal budget). Full collisions of the complete target: 0 (these are semi-free-start collisions from CV1, not from the IV; anyone can verify them offline with the 37-step compression). This tests that A0-variants of S (proof.md Lemmas 4.2, 4.3) are valid dense parts that reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions through every cell of rows 16..36 with their own W8 (Lemma 7.1), and that the counted program of this filing (table restricted to one class) finds exactly the constructed pair. It does not estimate q3. Observations (participant numbers): class_index, variant_index, l, checks_passed, restarts, proposals_row16, proposals_tail. detected_by_counted_program = 1 and counted_ops (operations counted for that detection) for all returned pairs of trials 0..15.

experiments.scope: Functional exactness only: H5 and Lemma 8.1 (proof.md Sections 8, 9 and 13.2); a consistency check, not a test, of H1, and not a test of the table of the whole family. The same program with the table restricted to the 222 embedded classes and THETA = 8 (the online program is the same for every THETA); trials 0..7 each run the counted online program (proof.md Section 8.3) on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 37-step compressions) until a first block has a record with kept fibres (at most 64 first blocks): the table read at x = A_{-1} (the record is built from the definition: the variants of every passing class grouped by equal W6 value, fibres of at least THETA kept), the fibre test of every batch, the scan of the pass plane, the segments of the passing fibres, u = W0 + s0(W1) in packed groups, the direct row-16 mask lookup of every lane, rows 17..36 for every row-16 pass. Every lane of every pass plane is checked against the scalar F6 test of its fibre value, the set of good variants of the record against the brute-force definition over all variants of the passing classes, and up to 12 good pairs against every cell of rows -4..15 for all 32 elements of L*. A trial returns the complete 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (l = 13) of its first good pair iff all checks passed. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 (rows 16..36 are not expected to hold). Mismatches of every kind: 0. Returned pairs: those trials whose first record with kept fibres had a good pair (a record can have kept fibres and no passing fibre, in which case no pair is returned). Observations (participant numbers): first_blocks, records_with_fibres, fibres, passing_fibres, good_pairs, row16_pairs, counted_ops, lane_mismatches, filter_mismatches, cell_mismatches, pairs_cell_checked. This tests the correctness of the counted fibre filter (H5, Lemma 8.1), the per-variant Step-2 equations and the validity of good pairs through row 15 (Lemma 4.3) on organizer-seeded first blocks; it does not test q3, H1 at scale, H3 or the table statistics.
